net.err_busy: The previous Wi-Fi change is still being applied, try again in a few seconds
net.err_invalid: The controller rejected the network name or password
net.err_pass_hex: A 64-character password must be a hexadecimal key (0-9, a-f)
net.err_pass_short: The password must be at least {min} characters, or empty for an open network
net.err_ssid_long: The network name is longer than {n} bytes
net.open_confirm: The password is empty, so "{ssid}" will be joined as an OPEN network without encryption. Continue?
net.pass_hint: {min}–{max} characters, or 64 hex digits. Leave empty only for an open network.
net.reconnect_warn: Saving makes the controller reconnect to the new network. This page may lose its connection; open the controller's new address afterwards.
net.ssid_hint: Up to {n} bytes (Cyrillic letters take 2 bytes each)
sensors.hint: Pick a name for each sensor found on the bus and press Assign. Choose “unassigned” to free a sensor.
sensors.none: No sensors found on the bus
sensors.replace: The sensor currently assigned to {name} is released.
sys.web_missing: The web files version is unknown (filesystem image missing or old).
sys.rolled_back: The last firmware update failed its health check and was rolled back.
sys.access_saved: Saved: the new password is active and the login is unchanged. Sign in with the new password.
sys.access_saved_user: Saved: the new login is active and the password is unchanged. Sign in with the new login.
sys.access_not_saved: Not saved: the session had already ended. The login and password are unchanged; sign in and save again.
sys.access_one: Change the password and the login one at a time: save the password first, sign in with it, then change the login.
sys.access_unknown: No confirmation: the new password may already be active; the login is unchanged. Sign in with the new password first; if that fails, the old one still applies.
sys.access_unknown_user: No confirmation: the new login may already be active; the password is unchanged. Sign in with the new login first; if that fails, the old one still applies.
sys.ota_relays: All relays are switched OFF during the update.
sys.ota_espota: Another update (espota) is in progress. Try again later.
sys.ota_wait: Waiting for the controller to come back…
sys.ota_noreply: The controller has not come back yet. Reload the page later.
sys.backup_failed: The backup could not be prepared
sys.backup_replace: Restoring replaces all current settings and sensor assignments.
sys.backup_relogin: If the backup changes the web login or password, sign in again with those.
sys.reset_done: Factory reset started. The controller restarts and opens the Wi-Fi network {ap}. Connect to it and open http://192.168.4.1/.
